question:
Identify from the given options the word which is similar in meaning to the following word.

Efface
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Efface"** means to erase (a mark) from a surface, or to make oneself appear insignificant or inconspicuous. (मिटाना)

 
 
• **Example: **Time alone will** efface **those unpleasant memories.
 
 
 
• **"Destroy" **refers to putting an end to the existence of something by damaging or attacking it. (नष्ट करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The earthquake had the power to **destroy** entire cities.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the meaning of **'Efface' **is similar to **'Destroy'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hidden** (छिपा हुआ): Something that is kept out of sight or concealed.

 
 
• **Example:** The treasure was hidden under the old oak tree.
 
 
 
• **Makeup** (सौंदर्य प्रसाधन): Cosmetics such as lipstick or powder applied to the face to enhance or alter the appearance.
 
 
• **Example:** She applied her makeup carefully before the event.
 
 
 
• **Daily** (प्रतिदिन): Happening or used every day.
 
 
• **Example:** He goes for a daily run in the park.
